description: Look up a Base transaction by hash and report whether it is pending, succeeded, or failed, with from, to, value, block number, and gas used. Use it to confirm a payment or contract call landed. Input: the transaction hash (0x + 64 hex; the 0x is optional).

hash.description: Transaction hash, 0x followed by 64 hex characters (the 0x prefix is optional).

title: Tx Status
